title: Towards Resource Efficient and Interpretable Bias Mitigation in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using global metrics (Regard and Toxicity differences across demographic groups using BOLD prompts) and local metrics (Hellinger distance between next-word probability distributions and Stereotype Scores using multiple-choice fill-in-the-blank tests from StereoSet). Also evaluated via counterfactual pronoun/noun substitution to measure next-word probability shifts for specific occupations.
